name: software
description: Four focused skills for planning, committing and reporting on software work: an 8-phase clean architecture vocabulary for classifying tasks (categorize-task), a planner that splits a master plan into per-phase plan files organized by feature track with complexity scores (split-plan), an interactive Conventional Commits generator that groups your changes and writes the messages (conventional-commit), and a daily handoff writer that gathers the last 24 hours of pull requests, review comments, AI coding sessions and uncommitted work into one plain-language status document (daily-handoff).
